# G16-12-RSV2-04 Phase-16: 27-probe production-native export-surface study

Task `G16-12-RSV2-04-p16`; `unified_study_v13`; branch `audit/gate-feasibility-bound`; execution commit `e2ef46b0693646697b6ccfe8de828e8094a77c94`. CPUs **10,11**, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`, requested **nice -n 10**, inherited effective nice **19**. No production edits. Authorized commit/push is a separate checkpoint after local validation; actual disposition is in `publication_result.json` and both trackers.

## Result

All **27** exact assigned EA × T_TIP × TAPER_X0 tuples completed production-native 2D gates/aesthetics, full exported-solid measurement, actual `export::surface_json` top-facet export, and distal section observations. **27/27 geometry/aesthetic passes**; **0/27 full native export passes**; **0 joint geometry/export passes**. One original-Q7 native control adds a 28th independent export invocation. The assigned 27 cases produce **18 distinct serialized native CAD surfaces**; repeated surface hashes are retained, with no substituted export executions.

Native component passes: **S1 apex 0/27**, **S2 point profile 0/27**, **S3 half-angle 27/27**, **bore 27/27**, **solid census/positive volume 27/27**. Measured apex exceeds .20 mm although the input EDGE_TH is .190 mm. Native point-profile non-monotonicity causes S2 failure; sampled thickness limits are shown below. All native S3 measurements satisfy25°. No complete native Gate S pass is claimed.

## Exact source and construction

Baseline is exact original Q7 (`SHA-256 0871168936d25b66a8bcd849193f63fd09f00185229f1cce8df71b0f43cd7e7a`); unassigned genes are unchanged, including original RING_WALL=6.4 mm. Outward normal increments are CP36+=.35 mm, CP37+=.52 mm, CP38+=.40 mm. Fixed EDGE_TH=.190 mm. Sweep EA_IN=EA_SP in18/18.3/18.5°, T_TIP in4.15/4.25/4.35 mm, TAPER_X0 in143/146/148.5 mm. CSV-to-canonical genes are exact for every case: no clipping or hidden clamp.

The wrapper includes the repository’s **unmodified production `pheno.rs`, `export.rs`, `certification.rs`, `gates.rs` and `aesthetic.rs` directly**. It calls production `pheno::build`, `gates::check`, `aesthetic::evaluate`, `certification::measure`, `export::solid` and `export::surface_json`. There is no compound/pocket module, no replacement thickness function, no artificial apex/angle override and no STUDY environment variables. EA/EDGE_TH/T_TIP/TAPER_X0 act through the native genome law only. Production source hashes are verified before and after execution.

Phase-14/V11 used the retained compound thickness construction; its successful point-cap/apex results are not a production-native parity control. This study intentionally uses the production-native surface requested here. It does not silently retain that compound point envelope or map gene values into internal knobs. Original-Q7 native control is preserved separately; it is not asserted equal to a compound control.

Native certification requests export area1.0 mm²; production `export::solid` caps RS-v2 meshing at .25 mm². Actual surface JSON is the native `jarambit.export_surface.v1` schema with native vertices and top facets, unchanged. SHA-256 binds the exact serialized bytes, not a profile label. Native S1 uses measured apex<=.20 mm, S2 uses the full native point-profile thickness/monotonicity/taper test, S3 uses measured facet half-angle<=25°. Bore>=1.5 mm and census[0,0,1]/positive volume are separately retained.

## Distal thickness and section modulus on actual exported CAD

The axis is the exact inward point bisector construction used by native certification. Sections are perpendicular to it at4/6/8/10/12/15 mm inward distance. Each section intersects the **actual saved native top facets**, interpolates their piecewise-linear heights and uses symmetric thickness t=2z. Polynomial integration on each nonoverlapping facet segment yields area A, lateral centroid, in-plane I=∫t(y−ybar)²dy, out-of-plane I=∫t³dy/12; in-plane Z=I/max extreme lateral distance and out-of-plane Z=I/(tmax/2). These are bending section properties in mm³, not a FEM solve, torsional section-factor replacement, strength SF or certification.

Facet segments are checked for overlap and positive thickness. Integration is exact for each linear facet segment up to floating-point arithmetic; no continuous-law re-sampling defines these reported CAD metrics. Equal surface hashes with equal axis/point use the same deterministic geometric postprocessing, while all27 native export executions remain independent. `native_cad_section_summary.csv` retains the full numeric table including I values, segment counts and centroids.
